title: Rajas con Crema Roasted Pepper Cream

description: Rajas con Crema is a beloved Mexican vegetarian dish featuring tender strips of roasted poblano peppers bathed in a rich, creamy sauce. This comforting and flavorful recipe offers a delightful balance of smoky heat and smooth dairy, making it an irresistible side or main course. It's a true taste of home, perfect for sharing with family and friends.

or heavy cream, sour cream can be thinned

instructions.title: Roast the Poblano Peppers
instructions.text: Place poblano peppers directly over an open flame on a gas stove or grill, turning frequently with tongs until the skin is completely charred and blistered. Alternatively, broil them in the oven until charred. Transfer the hot peppers to a bowl, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and let them steam for 10-15 minutes. This makes peeling easier.

instructions.title: Prepare the Rajas
instructions.text: Once cooled, peel the charred skin from the poblanos. Carefully remove the stems and seeds, then slice the peppers into thin strips (rajas). Set aside.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics
instructions.text: In a large skillet or non-stick pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the thinly sliced white onion and cook until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.

instructions.title: Combine with Rajas
instructions.text: Add the prepared poblano rajas to the skillet with the onions and garlic. Sauté for 3-5 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together. Season lightly with salt and pepper.

instructions.title: Create the Cream Sauce
instructions.text: Pour in the crema Mexicana and milk. Stir well to combine all ingredients. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, then reduce the heat to low. Stir in the corn kernels and continue to cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce slightly thickens and all ingredients are heated through.

instructions.title: Adjust Seasoning and Serve
instructions.text: Taste the rajas con crema and adjust salt and pepper as needed. Serve hot, garnished generously with crumbled queso fresco and fresh chopped cilantro.

instructions.title: Enjoy!
instructions.text: Serve as a side dish with tacos, enchiladas, or grilled meats, or enjoy on its own with warm tortillas.

tips: For a deeper smoky flavor, ensure the poblano peppers are well charred before steaming. The steaming step is crucial for easy peeling.

If crema Mexicana is unavailable, a mix of heavy cream and a dollop of sour cream (thinned with a little milk) can be a good substitute. Do not boil vigorously once the cream is added to prevent curdling.

Rajas con Crema is excellent served with warm corn tortillas for scooping, as a filling for quesadillas, or alongside huevos rancheros for breakfast. It stores well in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
